provenance.paper_title: PAL-UI: Planning with Active Look-back for Vision-Based GUI Agents

evidence.section: Full-paper method / memory representation and retrieval
evidence.paraphrase: A look-back tool recalls particular past screenshots.
A dual-level summarizer records observation cues and action outcomes linked to the trajectory.
A fixed summarizer compresses the growing GUI trajectory. For PAL-UI, this specifically supports episodic or hierarchical summarization of historical screenshots.
During operation, PAL-UI applies fixed-rule insertion or replacement to historical screenshots; the memory state changes while the governing update policy remains fixed.

derived.hybrid_relation: Distinct operative representation paths are explicitly linked for downstream retrieval, reasoning, or control.

adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (PDF p. 4): During inference, the operative memory component (historical screenshots) changes through episodic or hierarchical summarization, fixed-rule insertion or replacement; the governing policy remains fixed, and any learning reported by the paper occurs before deployment. Training-time learning, when present, was not counted as T3.
